beaches.name: Sougia (east end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern part of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to September 2023; a 2021 directory entry, a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2017-2024) name the same eastern section. A 2001 report mentions an old no-nudism sign that was ignored, and a 2018 note reports a village vote against beach camping; no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Kedrodasos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the whole beach, more nude at the eastern end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2018 ranging from 20% to 100% nude; a 2021 directory entry says about half; a Crete beach guide and a 2024 Greek listicle call it a naturist favourite. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Paleochora, Pachia Ammos (north end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the northern end of the long western town beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to October 2023 and describes signs near the taverna separating the nude and clothed sections; a Crete beach guide and Greek listicles (2017-2024) name the same end. Who placed the signs is not documented.

beaches.name: Gialiskari (Anidri beaches)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the eastern half of the easternmost Anidri beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to September 2023, placing the nude section beyond the first block of sunbeds; a 2016 note claims a tourist-office brochure mentions it, which is unverified. No signage is documented.
